title: Stigmata man at a UFO conference

tellings.quote: And one guy had the stigmata.

plain: At a UFO conference, a former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA once hired him to communicate with aliens, recalls meeting all sorts of people, and 'one guy had the stigmata,' bleeding wounds like those of the crucified Christ. Sherman tells Michels this as something he saw himself, a glimpse of the unusual crowd such events draw.
